propositions: Seven plan-review recommendations (R1-R7) from task-decomposition SOTA report must be integrated into the packaged review process with validation via experiments E1/E2/E3/E5/E6, with R6 shipping deterministically first and all others landing in advisory posture initially

Each recommendation is gated by its experiment's falsifiable acceptance criteria; E1 outcome corpus is frozen and committed, while E2/E3 batch-eval baselines were rescoped to d8a5 standing-dogfood monitoring (zero-LLM sidecar) to minimize cost

All implemented changes land directly into the packaged registry (criteria_routing.json, det_floor.py) with no config-flag overlay; advisory criteria auto-promote to blocking only when d8a5's trailing blocking-FP proxy metric stays below 10% threshold

R1/R3/R4 ship in advisory-only posture (never block plans) with bounded sanity checks and continuous production monitoring, replacing the original pre-ship batch-eval gate strategy per operator cost direction

R2's operator-attested DET lint extends det_floor.py (not criteria_routing.json); R5's kernel sub-answer requires IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION coordination with the floor-split story to avoid duplicate corpus segment bumps

Post-implementation validation uses R7 instrumentation to dogfood each criterion against the E1 outcome corpus; any criterion exceeding 10% blocking-FP rate is demoted to advisory via criteria_routing.json change, with advisory→blocking promotion gated on accumulated evidence
